contentHtml:
A good alarm scares off trouble before it starts and tells you the moment something is wrong. I install and update alarm systems for homes and businesses around Stretton and Brisbane, set them up to control from your phone, and tie them into your cameras so the whole property works as one. Tidy, and set up to suit how you actually live, with no monthly monitoring fee unless you want one.

Deter first, detect second

Most break-ins are about an easy, quiet target. A visible alarm and a loud siren take your place off that list, because being seen and heard is not worth the risk. That is the real value of an alarm, it stops trouble before it starts, and if someone does try, it makes enough noise to send them off and let you know straight away. On the bigger acreage blocks around the southside, the siren matters even more, since it needs to carry across a larger property.

In your control, on your phone

Arm and disarm from your phone, get an alert the instant a sensor trips, and check the status from anywhere. I set up door and window sensors, motion detectors and sirens to match your layout, and I can integrate the alarm with your CCTV cameras so a tripped sensor pulls up the footage. It also sits neatly alongside a smart home setup, so lights can come on when the alarm goes off.

Home and business

Whether it is the family home, a shopfront or an office, I match the system to the building and how it is used, and set it up so it is simple to live with rather than something you switch off because it is annoying.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
